scenes.say: Picture this. You see a house with solar shingles. They look amazing.
A Tesla Solar Roof replaces your entire roof. Panels sit on top of your existing one.
Per watt of capacity, solar roofs typically cost two to three times as much as panels.
Panels are more efficient per square foot, easier to repair, and widely available.

scenes.say: A solar roof mainly makes sense if you need a new roof anyway and love the look.
Torn between the two? Read the free guide at viva voltia dot com.
